title: Forensic Experiment 01: Empirical Audit of Silent Cloud Exfiltration, Security Alert Quiescence, and AI Training Policy Evolution (2024-2026)

creators.name: Zabala Cárcamo, Andrea
creators.affiliation: AndreTaker — BaBaYaga Core CyberDefense / Independent DFIR Researcher

description: Empirical digital forensics report documenting Experiment 01: full account data extraction and exfiltration without triggering cloud security notifications (Google). Analyzes the asymmetry between consumer security alerts and quiet mass data extraction, cross-referenced with 2024-2026 AI data harvesting policies and Julian Assange's declarations on transnational surveillance and tech monopolization.
